It owes the whole crate suites, intentsvcs's whole suite, the shell half, fmt, both clippy legs, the generator check and CI's doc command. Its landing chain owes `intent sync --to-store ST0056` for 0657's guard, vc's `at edit` of ST0087 AT-02.1, 0658's `ac edit ST0086 AC-02.6` with AT-02.6 re-cited and design.md's Primary paragraph, and each bank's CHANGELOG line, written by vc.
